main_body: marble column with capital, shaft, and base
top_band: light grey/white horizontal surface of the column capital across rows 9-11, followed by a bright white front-edge highlight at row 12
evidence: Reading down the center column: row 8 is the top outline; rows 9-11 form a 3px light grey top plane of the capital; row 12 is a bright white 1px front-edge line; rows 13-16 are the shaded front face and underside of the capital overhanging the shaft (which has an eave shadow at rows 16-17); rows 17-40 are the cylindrical shaft; rows 41-46 are the base with its own top shelf (rows 41-43) and front edge (row 44).

style.evidence: The column uses a 6-step cool grey/white ramp with smooth cylindrical form shading, specular highlights, and dark slate-grey outlines matching the stone palette. While cleaner and smoother than the multi-material stall and well references (appropriate for polished marble), it avoids flat fills via vertical shading gradients and subtle pixel variation.
